svg.title: Invoices built from billable time — SoftTrack web design mockup (#300)
svg.desc: Billable hours and rebillable expenses add up to what a customer owes, and the adding up is where hours get billed twice or not at all. An invoice is for a customer and a period in one currency; a draft collects what has not been billed; approval freezes the lines, numbers the invoice and locks the worklogs on it.
svg.text: · hours billed once, and not twice or not at all
What a customer owes, added up once

can be edited, removed or added; approval freezes the lines and gives the number from a sequence; a worklog or expense is on one invoice and is locked once it is approved; a
tax line is typed by finance; and the invoice downloads as PDF and CSV.
